rows.name_now: leading oya-/cloud- on crates, gates, bins, faces

rows.chestertons_fence: ADR-0017 / crate-naming-convention required oya- for workspace uniqueness mirroring aws-/google-cloud- prefix shapes.
rows.indefensible: required_prefix=oya- / cloud-ci-* as greenfield forever grammar
